desc: 直击头屑瘙痒尴尬，强效成分机制可视化，全发质适用清新洗感
name: 去屑止痒强效洗发水款

shots.intent: 瓶加盒正面无影棚展示，建立品类识别与品质第一印象
抓头与镜前查发的痛点情绪钩子，右侧接提问文案打开漏斗
差异化成分 USP 建立护城河认知，措辞只引用可验证事实

斜瓶水花高速摄影，把清洁力与清爽可视化
中心包装加左右引线汇总核心利益，完成利益证明
分屏模特加三行发质清单，覆盖染烫、化学处理、灰白发人群

style.backgroundSystem: high-key white and light-blue gradient photo backdrops; flat cyan #1E9BD7 claim tiles; deep-blue #123C6B closing banners; no dark or warm-orange grounds
style.direction: clinical-fresh pharmacy OTC aesthetic on a cold blue system: deep navy product, flat cyan claim tiles, high-key white scenes, amber headlines only
style.iconSystem: thin horizontal leader lines, short divider bars, neutral water-drop and shield line icons; no real certification badges
style.lightingSystem: soft high-key softbox with no heavy shadows; bright window light for lifestyle; high-speed flash look for water splashes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clinical-fresh pharmacy OTC aesthetic on a cold blue system - deep navy product #1E2A6E, flat cyan claim tiles #1E9BD7, light sky gradients #BFE3F2, high-key white scenes #F2F4F5, amber-yellow #F5A623 reserved exclusively for bold uppercase headlines against white subcopy. Lighting is always soft, high-key and shadowless: softbox frontal-top for product, bright window light for lifestyle, high-speed flash to freeze water splashes. Layouts follow a strict grammar: split-screen portraits with the subject left and cyan text panel right, or top-image bottom-banner structures; mechanism tiles are pure typography with a giant centered numeral; benefit diagrams use a centered pack with horizontal leader lines. No dark or warm-orange backgrounds, no diseased-scalp close-ups - pain is conveyed through gesture and expression - no fabricated certifications, and all efficacy and exclusivity claims come only from verified product facts with compliance-safe footnotes. Brand names, pack text and codes are always stripped and replaced with neutral label art.
noDrift: no brand names or real pack text
efficacy multipliers and exclusivity claims only from verified product facts
no dark warm-orange or fluorescent palettes
no other product lines mixed in
style.presentationRules: portraits always split-screen or top-image-bottom-banner; product always frontal and unobstructed; claim tiles keep product under 35%; pain shown through gesture not diseased scalps; 30-40% text whitespace
style.surfaceSystem: seamless white studio base; matte white tile and pale walls in scenes; reflective floor for splash shots
style.temperature: cool, with neutral-warm skin tones only
style.typography: bold uppercase sans headlines alternating amber #F5A623 and white, thin white subcopy, thin horizontal leader lines with silver-gray dividers
